messages:
jordan: Heads-up — product wants a per-route "minimal logging" switch in Console to reduce telemetry cost for high-volume chatty routes. Thinking: default-off, canary on a few tenants. Concerns: quota accounting, PII redaction preservation, and request routing fallbacks.

mike: +1 for default-off. need to ensure sampling still captures errors and slow requests. we should surface a sampled-error override. :thumbsup:

tara: UX question — is this per-route only, or route+model? we have customers with same route but multiple model variants (v1/v2) so cost diff matters.

jordan: route+model makes sense technically but complicates the Console. maybe start with per-route with optional model-granularity later.

ops-bot: AUTO: rate-limit-policy: tenants using minimal-logging will still count against quota buckets. See /policies/quota for details.

elaine: PII note: minimal logging must still run redaction pipeline. we cannot ship raw snippets even if sampled down. redaction -> then sampling. that dictates pipeline ordering.

prashant: Agree with ordering. Also: if we sample after redaction we lose provenance for debugging (e.g., exact prompt). Suggest we emit a small fingerprint (hmac) for sampled-out requests so we can correlate without storing content.

kyle: For rollout, propose: 1) backend feature gate + telemetry flag 2) console toggle with canary percent 3) default minimal logging for test tenants only. Also: an observation dashboard with heatmap showing token-cost delta.

mike: Example sampling config I mocked for runtime:
``` 
{
  "route": "/v1/complete/chat",
  "minimal_logging": true,
  "sample_policy": {
    "base_rate": 0.01,
    "error_rate_override": 1.0,
    "slow_request_ms": 800
  },
  "retain_fingerprint": true
}
```
Use base_rate to throttle telemetry volume but always keep errors/slow traces.

elaine: +1 on fingerprint HMAC. ensure we hash with tenant-specific key and rotate keys. doc that we never store unhashed content.

prashant: Metrics to expose to Console: sampled_rate, estimated_tokens_saved, missed-regressions (from eval sets). Also a quick-link to query example in Metrics: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/req-logging-savings (dev-only link)

jordan: One product ask: show estimated monthly $savings per-route if enabled. we can compute from token rates and current unit price. show an uncertainty band.

kyle: Two safety UX items: (a) warning banner if route has high PII-risk score, (b) require two-step enable (enable in dev then prod).

mike: Operational note: when minimal_logging toggles on, we should emit an audit event and snapshot the current sampling policy so rollbacks restore.

elaine: Legal wanted retention TTL on sampled payloads: max 30 days unless tenant opts in. add retention metadata to the toggle UI.

jordan: Action items: @mike implement sample-policy schema + error override (PR by EOD Wed), @kyle mock Console wireframes (tomorrow), @elaine write redaction+fingerprint spec (Fri), @prashant produce grafana dashboard query and demo data (next Tue). I'll coordinate canary tenants.

mike: ack. I'll also add an audit-event type `minimal_logging.toggle` with who/when/route/model.

tara: small ask — can we add a tooltip explaining that sampling reduces telemetry fidelity and to link to best-practices doc? product will lap that up.

jordan: yes. I'll draft the doc blurb. thanks all.

ops-bot: REMINDER: run smoke test after rollout. job: rollout-smoke-minimal-logging. scheduled at 2025-06-05T02:00Z.
